content: Irudeme obeegiri-ka
Ka Iesu-ro ruu iimatomudio mereei obeegiri imoaduꞌoi-ka, rii ma imatomudioi-ri, rii turiaha ma irudemeumo aiboi, ka irudemei-da rii haꞌima aꞌaimoꞌai-ri.
Iesu-ro aaꞌoi-ka,

content.text: “Goꞌoto ata-to ai-pemidio bubui umoo hiꞌa dubu ata, Iehomai-do toe iꞌatidio bia, kamia uubi imaabeedio bia.

Ka oobo himu ata, aaꞌo goꞌotoi-da pemidio, ruu ai-poroohodio, aaꞌo dubui eito, ruu kiritooto iemaꞌatidio mereei bubui-da ma omodadeai-ri. Ruu-ro aaꞌoi-ka, ‘Moo romoabai, moo meree ata-ro kiritooto remaꞌatidio!’
Tutuu himio, ruu rio tiato piꞌatidio omoabai, irai iarai-da, ruu himiai-do oromoaduꞌoi-ka, ‘Moo Iehomai-do toe iꞌatidio bia, kamia moo uubi imaabeedio bia,

irai ara oobo himui-ro, turiaha himioi moo aiha romorooho, aaꞌo rau-ri, moo-ro eaꞌai raꞌai ruu odomoiai bubui-da. Mabu moo-ro aꞌai tiato-ra, ruu aiha oroohoi aꞌai, ka iarai-da, moo haꞌima ododiai aꞌai!’”

content: Ka Paidubui-ro aaꞌoi-ka,

content.text: “Oromidioumo, ire bubui umoo hiꞌa dubui aaꞌo raai, irai ruu memiho-ka.
Ida Iehoma-ro, ruu himia uubi bubui-da imoabai amaꞌai, ruu himio-ra duo-raida atohei-ri, ma imoabai-ri? Modobo-ka. Kamia ruu-ro rii emera-ha imoabai amaꞌai? Abiarie, modobo bia.
Moo-ro riꞌo ai-riduuꞌai, rii rioi-da bubui-da imoabai aꞌai, ka hio hiꞌai-to ododiai aꞌai. Irai Uubihaubi Mereei ooꞌui aꞌai-da, pupuo iraromo moꞌui emeeꞌai amaꞌai ara hepui-da?”

content: Retoꞌa dubuoti irudemeai iodaido obeegiri-ka
Aamiꞌa uubi-ro ai-piraromoumo, rii beha mea-ka, rii iraromoi-da uubi amiꞌai mea bia, kaida pimoaduꞌo Iesu-ro, ara obeegiri.

content.text: “Retoꞌa dubuoti, ai-piioido irudeme motoi-da irudemeai, atai Pariseia dubu-ka, atai taketi imoamee dubui-ka.

“Ka Pariseia dubui ruu himia-ha pitooꞌa, iirudemeai-da paaꞌo, ‘Iehoma-o, moo keito raaꞌo rooi-do, moo turiaha uubi aibo bia, moo iiho-toto meree bia, moo erematuhuti meree bia, kamia moo imo-dubu bia, kamia moo aire taketi imoamee dubui aibo bia.
Moo puura gaaꞌui goroi-da retoꞌa himio, imaꞌui emidioi-ka, kamia moo puura gaaꞌui goroi-da, imeeꞌatuti teri (10) raarai-da, gaaꞌubuoi roo emaꞌai-ka.’
“Irai taketi imoamee dubui auꞌo aibo haato pitooꞌa, ruu hohoi imaromia bia aromoi eito, gomoi aramaꞌedeai-ka, ida paaꞌo, ‘Iehoma-o, moo giiꞌepu remaꞌai, moo memiho meree-ka.’”

content: Iesu-ro aaꞌoi-ka,

content.text: “Riꞌo moo-ro ai-riduuꞌai, riiti iodaidoi-da himia-himia motoi eito, Iehoma hohoi-da mea hiꞌa iiꞌi mereei taketi iimoamee dubui-ka, Pariseia dubui bia. Boiꞌo-ro, moroomomiourio duumo, rii ioruoi aꞌai kaumo, kamia boiꞌo-ro, moromomoruodio duumo, rii iioi aꞌai kaumo.”

content: Iesu-ro meree keekei iahoꞌoi-ka
Uubi aamiꞌai, meree keekei ai-pimooꞌumo, Iesu tui rii hoꞌui-da ma iaaꞌoi-ri, kaida iimatomudio mereei-ro, ieaꞌaumoi-da erehe madei-to pimaaꞌoumo,
irai, Iesu-ro meree keekei aiha piahoꞌoo, ida paaꞌo

content.text: “Imeheaimo, meree keekei mooꞌumo-ka mooi-do, mabu Iehoma pai emidio erarai, rii aibo uubi-ro eidai aꞌai kaumo.
Moo-ro riꞌo ihaha riduuꞌai, boꞌu-ro eidai tiato maꞌai, meree keehi aibo, Iehoma pai emidio erarai, ruu-ro odoroi aꞌai bia.”

content: Raara hiiro-hiiro dubui-ka
Iuda epuuhoro dubu ata-ro, Iesu atohetai-ka, “Mea imatomudio dubu-o, moo raꞌu ododiai raꞌai tutuu oroiꞌioi ma reidai-ri?”
Iesu-ro, ruu atohetai-ka,

content.text: “Roo-ro moo raꞌu-ri meai-to rahoꞌoo? Meree gaaꞌu ata mea bia, Iehoma beha-ka.
Roo umoo-ka Iehoma bubui, ‘Imo aꞌai bia, maꞌoamo aꞌai bia, piro aꞌai bia, meree ata paira ematuhuti aibo, ahoꞌoi bia, roo maamu-ra, abea-rai, ma imaabei.’”

content: Aaꞌo dubui-ro omoaimai-ka, “Moo keehibuoi imooꞌu doꞌou, moo-ro ara bubui turiaha tauo pirimaabedio.”
Iesu-ro aaꞌo madei ioroomai-da, ruui-do aaꞌoi-ka,

content.text: “Gaaꞌu hiꞌa raa ireirie, roo-ro ma ododiai, roo reꞌei-da iiꞌaa raarai turiaha taꞌii-to ita omameumo, ka mori raara tiato uubi ita imaꞌati, kaida roo-ro, meamea raarai imeeꞌai aꞌai aromoi-da, ka ooꞌu, moo robodo.”

content: Irai aaꞌo dubui-ro, ara madei ioroomai-da, ruu giiꞌepu hiꞌa paꞌai, mabu ruu raara hiiro-hiiro dubu-ka.
Iesu-ro, ruu giiꞌepu hohoi ieaꞌai-da, paaꞌo,

content.text: “Aahuu hiꞌa-ka, raara hiiro-hiiro mereei-ro, Iehoma pai emidio erarai goroi odoroi,
aahuu-ka kameroi, iroi gaꞌerei ma odoroi, kaida aahuu hiꞌa-ka raara hiiro-hiiro mereei-ro, Aiai Iehoma pai emidio erarai goroi odoroi.”

content: Ioromidioumo uubi-ro, ruu atohetaimoi-ka, “Ka roo aaꞌo raarai ihaha-ro ooꞌaato, tutuu oroiꞌioi boꞌu-ro eidai maꞌai?”
Iesu-ro imoaimai-ka,

content.text: “Raꞌu-rie modobo tiato raai uubi eito, Iehomai-do modobo-ka.”

content: Kaida Petero-ro aaꞌoi-ka, “Ka ma emeeꞌa, rimo goꞌoto-goꞌotoi ai-pirimeheaimo, roo ma robodoumoi-ri.”
Iesu-ro aaꞌoi-ka rii-do,

content.text: “Moo-ro, riꞌo ihaha riduuꞌai, meree ata-ro, goꞌotoi aia memeheai, ooboi-re, riaraamui-re, maamu-ra abea-raire, kamia mereei-re, Iehoma pai emidio erarai iraromoi-ri,
ruu-ro hiiro hiꞌa meai imidai aꞌai ara ooꞌa himioi-da, ka tutuu oroiꞌioi, emaꞌai aꞌai ooꞌui aꞌai himioi-da.”

content: Iesu iihiai ioaduꞌoi-ka Ierusaremaato
Iesu-ro ruu iimatomudio tuero (12) mereei, imodadeai-ka kekai eito, ida paaꞌo rii-do,

content.text: “Oromidioumo! Rimo ai-riioo kaumo Ierusaremai-to, ka turiaha raarai iaha hiꞌai oobodi aꞌai kaumo himogabo uubi-ro iꞌatimo emerai Uubihaubi Mereei-ri.
Ruu emaꞌai aꞌai kaumo Iuda guui-da paira tiato uubi eito, ka madei-da emerioi aꞌai kaumo, omomoruodioi aꞌai kaumo, ka oobei-da mamouti duumo.
Ka rii-ro ruu ororihoi aꞌai kaumo, ka maiꞌia duumo rituo-ha, irai retoꞌa-gaaꞌu (3) himioi didimoi-da, oroitorai aꞌai oroiꞌioi eito.”

content: Irai iimatomudio tuero (12) mereei-ro, umoo iiꞌimo bia, ruu turiaha iaaꞌo raarai, madei iha hiꞌai ai-pimoapiꞌoma rii reꞌei-da, kamia rii-ro umoo iiꞌimo bia, Iesu ioroaduꞌuti raarai.
Iesu-ro idomai tiato dubui iodomoiai-ka
Iesu Ieriko taitai ioohiai-da, idomai tiato dubu ata, gaboi barai-da pemidio, ai-poroarodio.
Kaida piromidio uubi hiiroi iorohotutimoi-da, ruu-ro araatoi-ka, “Raꞌu maꞌai duumo?”
Rii-ro ruu oduuꞌaimoi-ka, “Rasareta dubui Iesu-ro orohodi.”
Ruu-ro geema madei-to aaꞌoi-ka, “Damida mereei Iesu-o, moo giiꞌepu remaꞌai!”
Iesu hoho reꞌei imadaꞌuimo uubi-ro udoi-to ai-pemaaꞌoumo, ka oduuꞌaimoi-ka piroha ma iiꞌi-ri, irai pairautu hiꞌa madei-to aaꞌoi-ka, “Damida mereei-o, moo giiꞌepu remaꞌai!”
Iesu iimadaꞌui-da, otoꞌai-ka, ida paaꞌo,

content.text: “Omooꞌumo,”

content: ka omooꞌumoi-ka Iesu taitai eito, Iesu-ro atohetai-ka,

content.text: “Roo raꞌu rio maꞌai, moo-ro ma romododiai?”

content: Ka ruu-ro omoaimai-ka, “Paidubu-o, moo rio-ka ma riaꞌa.”
Iesu-ro aaꞌoi-ka ruui-do,

content.text: “Ka iaꞌa! Roo pupuo iraromoi-ro, tauo odomoia maaka.”

content: Ruu idomai gaaꞌu hiꞌa-ha odomoiai-ka, kiauka aiha pomahoro Iesu obodoi, Iehoma emarahue-ha. Turiaha uubi-ro ieaꞌaumoi-da, Iehoma aiha pemarahueumo.
